title: Grateful Dead Live at Dallas Memorial Auditorium on 1972-11-24
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Sharp soundboard capture of a fiery 1972 performance with monster Jerry leads and standout Box of Rain, Truckin' and Black Throated Wind.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that is generally clear though it suffers a few mix hiccups (notably on "Don’t Ease Me In" and "El Paso") and a muddy edge. Musically the show is high‑energy, with Jerry’s incendiary leads, Phil’s solid bass work and several highlight moments such as Box of Rain, Truckin', Sugar Magnolia, Black Throated Wind and Ramble On. Overall the concert is regarded as one of the better post‑Europe dates despite minor technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating across nine reviews is ~4.3; most reviewers praise the performance and deem the recording good, with only occasional minor criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard capture but a few mix hiccups ("Don’t Ease Me In", "El Paso") and a slightly muddy texture; one disappointing cut on the China Cat solo.

poor_songs: Not Fade Away (Jerry string break issues)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set noted for its oomph and solid country‑inflected vibe; second set intensifies with fiery solos and tight band interplay, delivering a professional post‑Europe feel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Monstrous leads praised, occasional vocal space‑out, string break on "Not Fade Away", strong guitar fills on Box of Rain, heavy use of harmonics in Truckin' outro.
band_member_comments.Bob: Sprightly guitar fills noted on Box of Rain; solo at end of China Cat described as disappointing.
